name: lesslong
title: lesslong
blurb: LessWrong's Sequences, boiled down to one plain-English paragraph per article at an eighth-grade reading level — off @joetforhire.com's "getting an LLM to autosummarize lesswrong" bit, requested by @fubarchitect.com. Now also live-tracks recent LessWrong posts above a karma cutoff you pick (10/100/500), per @robmurrish.bsky.social.
